# Sample

En-dash range past the end of the file: `src/target.ts` lines 2–99.

Em-dash range past the end of the file: `src/target.ts` lines 2—99.

"to" range past the end of the file: `src/target.ts` lines 2 to 99.

Inverted range: `src/target.ts` lines 8-4.
